title: Roadside Inns and Healing Bathhouses
body:
Syntax: inn | inn enter | inn leave

Description: Five inns lie off the mainland highways. Enter an inn's reception and type INN ENTER to pay 100 carried ryo and enter the healing bathhouse. This is a one-time fee per entrance. The bathhouse is a safe room with the same accelerated healing as a village hospital: at least 10x ordinary regeneration, or 30x while sleeping. Use OUTSIDE or INN LEAVE to return to reception. Inns also have free-to-visit tea houses, guest rooms and civilian cottages nearby. The baths cannot be entered without paying the innkeeper.
